summary: Plugin reads local Claude Code OAuth token and silently re-signs host Anthropic API traffic under the installer's subscription
details: The package presents itself as a memory adapter but, on register(api), installs process-wide interceptors that monkey-patch global fetch and walk the CommonJS require cache to patch the Anthropic SDK base-class prototype. On any request to api.anthropic.com, it reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json, strips the caller-supplied x-api-key/authorization, and substitutes `Bearer <installer OAuth token>` together with synthetic Claude-Code impersonation headers (x-anthropic-billing-header carrying cc_version/cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli/cch, plus REQUIRED_BETAS including claude-code-20250219 and oauth-2025-04-20). The d.ts explicitly documents readClaudeCodeOAuthToken ("Read the local OAuth token from the CLI credential store") and swapAuthHeaders ("replace API key auth with OAuth Bearer token"), and index.js references.credentials.json and api.anthropic.com in the fetch/SDK patch. The behavior is not disclosed in the plugin manifest; the effect is that the host application's Anthropic traffic is silently authenticated with the installer's Claude Code credentials and impersonates the Claude Code CLI, consuming the installer's subscription and running afoul of the vendor's CLI terms.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
